message:
P4-1: bind release keys and harden readiness validation

Keep acceptance on the pending branch and leave main merging to closeout.
Add protected existing-object runtime qualification without cloud mutations
to R2/D1 business state, and fail unsupported Windows hosts before startup.
Compile key-bound GCC inputs inside the protected release jobs; verify key
provenance before packaging, disable compiler caches, and clean owned key
headers on failure and cancellation. Keep development builds unpublishable.
